open_questions: Halo is a translucent gold sphere (1.3x planet radius). Want a ring or a different colour?
Buy works only on the mission planet (abundant energy, scarce food) for now. Should every planet sell ships later?
Ships panel sits at a fixed offset_top 170 under the board; fine if the board grows to more missions?
handoff: Press New Game, Start. Planet 1 pulses gold. Click it, press 'Buy a ship (1000 cr)' (works while paused). Cash drops, Ships panel shows 1 / 8, mission reads '(complete)', pulse stops. Button is disabled with a reason when cash is short or the cap is reached. Ship count is autosaved (key 'ships', default 0, VERSION unchanged); Continue restores it with no pulse if a ship was bought. Headless load of main.tscn is clean. Not verified: visuals of the halo and layout, and the save round trip (sandbox blocks user://).
